nodes.rationale: DOI 10.23960/jitet.v13i3.6558 - SAW smartphone recommender for Toko Marva Jaya Ratulangi (Palopo) with 4 criteria (Harga 5 Cost, Baterai 3, Resolusi Kamera 4, Memori 4, all Benefit) over 7 brands; OPPO ranked first (0.2); PHP/MySQL on XAMPP; accuracy vs Excel = 100%.
